title: You Must See ‘You Can See Everything.’ Plus: Judd Apatow!
format: A long dig into Fielder and Oppenheim's Elizabeth Holmes documentary, then Judd Apatow on his two new comedy docs and a career in comedy.

segments.heading: The news
segments.note: the Narnia trailer, Zendaya, and a crowded weekend

films.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
films.note: Greta Gerwig's adaptation, story moved 50 years forward to post-war England with a Stairway to Heaven rock-opera vibe. Split on the video-game-ish CGI worlds; the real-England footage looks good. Theaters Feb 12, Super Bowl weekend.

films.title: Barbie
films.note: Gerwig's last trailer drew the same 'what the fuck is this,' then played once you saw it big.

films.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
films.note: The 2000s trilogy shot in real places and still not well made; proof that natural locations don't automatically fix it.

films.title: Ex Machina
films.note: The stripped-down Garland mode they'd welcome, slotted between Elden Ring and his new Zendaya A24 sci-fi.

films.title: Remain
films.note: Shyamalan/Nicholas Sparks movie marketed as Valentine's, actually out Feb 5.

films.title: Digger
films.note: In full awards-screener frenzy; Neil Young called it the greatest film ever made. Sean wonders if the backlash-to-the-backlash is coming.

films.title: La Bola Negra
films.note: In a limited number of theaters, worth the biggest screen; they'll cover it properly when it hits Netflix.

films.title: Fjord
films.note: Palme d'Or winner, early best-picture tip, now in three LA theaters with Neon seemingly shifting energy elsewhere.

films.title: The Devils
films.note: Ken Russell restoration out this weekend; saved for the annual horror episode.

films.title: Whale Fall
films.note: Out this weekend, covered Monday.

films.title: Sense and Sensibility
films.note: New adaptation out this weekend, covered next week.

films.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
films.note: Noah Segan directing John Turturro.

films.title: Misty Green
films.note: Chris Rock's movie, covered later this month.

films.title: You Can See Everything
films.note: Fielder and Oppenheim's Elizabeth Holmes documentary. Opens verite in the family's rented Del Mar house in the 34 days before prison, then at the halfway mark jumps two years and pulls in Amanda Seyfried to recreate Holmes. A movie about language, truth, and whether Holmes is a con, a misunderstood mind, or another woman ensnared by a domineering man. Both call it the movie of the year; Seyfried's work, both acting and not acting, is the awards question.

films.title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
films.note: Three years following Bamford; started as a one-woman-show idea, became a doc about comedy and mental health through deaths in her family and the Altadena fires.

films.title: Norm
films.note: All-archival portrait of Norm Macdonald, no talking heads; the theory being you can't crack him, only arrange what he put into the world. Ends on the Largo set two years before his death.

films.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
films.note: Harold Ramis walked teenage Apatow through filmmaking while prepping it.

films.title: The Devil and Daniel Johnston
films.note: A touchstone for the Bamford doc.

films.title: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
films.note: The Lonely Island's send-up of the fluff-piece pop doc; the opposite of what Apatow chases.

films.title: Knocked Up
films.note: Rewatched for the 4K prep; hadn't seen it since release, laughed the whole way, everyone had the eye of the tiger.

films.title: Funny People
films.note: Part of the transparently personal run.

films.title: This Is 40
films.note: Also rewatched for 4K; going back feels like time travel, which is why he avoids it.

films.title: The King of Staten Island
films.note: Same process as the docs: sitting with Pete Davidson asking how he got here and what healing would take.

films.title: Step Brothers
films.note: The one he'll rewatch all the way through every time.

films.title: Gilbert
films.note: Neil Berkeley's Gilbert Gottfried doc; Apatow called him to make the Bamford film.

films.title: The Zen Diaries of Garry Shandling
films.note: Two-part Shandling doc; made with real observations from life, some of which held up.

films.title: George Carlin's American Dream
films.note: Carlin got darker on stage while getting lighter in life; the America montage they feared was too political.

films.title: The Comeback King
films.note: His new film, co-written with Glenn Powell, about a country star in freefall. Shoot-the-script-then-toss-it method, new to Powell.
